Name: Rustic Soda Machine
Author: LilyMods
Description:
[center][b][u][size=6]A Rustic Soda Machine[/size][/u][/b]

This is a texture redesign for the Soda Machine that comes from completing the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Joja_Community_Development_Form]Joja Community Development[/url]
My intention was so that you could closely match it with the base game's kitchen decour.[b]
It still only produces Joja Cola
[/b]

[u][b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b][/u]

Uses content patcher so it's a piece of cake to install.
Just place the uncompressed folder into your Mods folder or use any mod manager to do it for you.
